Lithos has no linked record in this batch because the related AGATAkit X1 LVC source returned 404 and is kit-specific. Thangram has no exact matching catalogue record.
Current Videx 4212 audio page contains a conflicting V-suffix in its variant table. Image filename and original AN0029 establish 4212 audio; no V/video identity was inferred.

Only the outer white margins of the Videx 4000/8000/VR4K manufacturer composites were cropped, preserving the complete family badge and all assemblies. Exact exclusive crop bounds and original/delivered hashes are recorded per candidate.
Only manifests and selected image assets are intended for importer integration. PDF downloads, HTML snapshots, extracted text and superseded images remain intermediate research.
